subject: Request: split today's interview after allergic reaction — options and plan
messages:
From: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@gmail.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Urgent: need to change today's interview

Hi Laura / Rishi —

I am so sorry to do this last-minute. I had a bad allergic reaction this morning and ended up in urgent care. I am out of the hospital now and stable, but the doctor advised rest for the rest of the day. I really want to continue with the process — I can do a shorter, single 45-minute technical screen later today around 17:00–18:30 PT if that helps, otherwise I need to push the full loop to next week.

Attached a quick note from urgent care (PDF) — happy to reschedule the rest of the loop. Apologies for the disruption and for the short notice.

Thanks for understanding,
Elliot Ramos
(415) 555-0119

Attachments: doctor-note.pdf (PDF, 23 KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@gmail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-01T16:19:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: need to change today's interview

Hi Elliot —

Thank you for the update and I hope you feel better soon. No worries about the notice — we can be flexible. Two options:

1) We can run a single 45-minute technical screen with Rishi today between 17:00–18:00 PT and move the remaining interviews to next week.
2) Or we can postpone the whole loop and reschedule three back-to-back interviews next week (I can propose slots).

Which would you prefer? If option 1, is 17:00 PT good? I will confirm interviewer availability.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference

On a separate note, I received your urgent care note; I added it to the candidate file.
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-01T16:24:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Elliot needs to change today's interview — can we do a 45-min screen at 17:00?

Team — forwarding Elliot's note. He can do a single 45-minute technical screen today at 17:00 PT if someone can take it (we'd then move the remaining interviews to next week). Otherwise we should hold and reschedule.

Proposed plan if you can take it: Rishi does a focused system-design + coding micro-loop (45 min). We'll reschedule the hiring manager and product loop for next week. I attached a tentative calendar stub (updated-itinerary.ics) for the 45-min slot.

Please reply just with your availability (YES / NO and if NO, propose times).

Thanks —Laura

Attachment: updated-itinerary.ics (stub)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-01T16:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Elliot needs to change today's interview — can we do a 45-min screen at 17:00?

YES for 17:00 PT — I can cover behavioral and product questions if Rishi wants to focus purely on technical. Happy to bridge.

Mina — are you able to join for the coding piece? If not, we can move Mina's slot to next week.

Lauren

Sorry — I can't make 17:00 PT today, I'm on calls until 18:30 PT. I can do tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT or Friday afternoon. I'm fine with my portion being moved to next week. If you want to proceed with a single 45-min session today, I suggest Rishi handles coding and Lauren does the higher-level behavioral.

If we reschedule, I'd vote for two short sessions rather than three back-to-back for candidate comfort (e.g., 60 min + 60 min on separate days).

—Mina
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@gmail.com>

Date: 2028-06-01T22:05:00Z
Subject: Confirmed: 45-min technical screen today at 17:00 PT (rest to be rescheduled)

Hi Elliot —

Thanks for confirming options. We will do a single 45-minute technical screen today at 17:00 PT with Rishi and a short behavioral portion with Lauren. Mina won't be able to join today and we'll reschedule her session for next week (I will send reschedule proposals tomorrow).

Calendar: I've sent an updated invite (attachment: updated-itinerary.ics). Please let me know ASAP if anything changes. We greatly appreciate you keeping us posted and wish you a smooth recovery.

Best,
